audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted both the packet and the page's own why text: level 1 was given to Gangplank though whys[0] says 'the early edge is yours'; levels 3 and 4-5 were given to Irelia though whys[3] calls it a coin-flip; first item was Irelia though whys[5] says he controls the lane; 2+ items was Irelia though whys[6] says it is even at best.
audit.why: The mirror audit (gangplank__irelia) already resolved this chart to Irelia, Irelia, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, which is exactly the packet levelChart. Restating the same result from Irelia's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions told you to track Powder Keg's cooldown, but Powder Keg has no cooldown at all (cd 0) — the real timer to track is Remove Scurvy, which cleanses your E-stun and heals him. Grievous Wounds was never mentioned, and the itemization block recommends Plated Steelcaps without noting Cannon Barrage deals true damage.
audit.why: Riot's kit gives Powder Keg a 0s cooldown and 1000 range; Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s and is a cleanse plus heal, which is the one timer that decides whether your Flawless Duet stun sticks. Cannon Barrage is flagged trueDamage, so stacking resistances is the wrong answer to it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now names Remove Scurvy's 14s rank-5 timer and states Powder Keg has no cooldown; Key Ability Interactions says bait the cleanse before you stun; itemization now routes to Executioner's Calling for the heal.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy: matchup-defining — it cleanses your E-stun and heals him; 14s at rank 5, so bait it before you commit. - Powder Kegs has no cooldown: only three stored barrels limit him. - Your ultimate: kill windows.
